taslaklar.kime: Hedef Alman üniversitesi — Studierendensekretariat / International Office
taslaklar.konu: Deutschsprachiger Bachelor: anerkannte Sprachnachweise und Abgabefrist (Bewerbung aus der Türkei, Wintersemester 2028/29)
taslaklar.metin:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
ich besuche ein 12-jähriges allgemeinbildendes Gymnasium in Istanbul (Lise Diplomasi, MEB) und möchte mich für den deutschsprachigen Bachelorstudiengang [Name] zum Wintersemester 2028/29 bewerben. Die Hochschulzugangsberechtigung werde ich über die YKS-Platzierung in einem vierjährigen Lisans-Studiengang derselben Fachrichtung nachweisen.
1) Welche Sprachnachweise akzeptieren Sie für diesen Studiengang (z. B. TestDaF mit TDN 4 in allen Teilen, telc Deutsch C1 Hochschule, Goethe-Zertifikat C1 oder C2, DSD II)? Akzeptieren Sie das Goethe-Zertifikat C1?
2) Gibt es für diesen Studiengang ein abweichendes Sprachniveau (z. B. DSH-1 oder TDN 3 mit Auflage)?
3) Muss der Sprachnachweis bis zur Bewerbungsfrist (15. Juli) vorliegen oder kann er bis zur Einschreibung nachgereicht werden?
4) Kann der YKS-Platzierungsbescheid, der voraussichtlich im August veröffentlicht wird, nachgereicht werden?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Name, Geburtsdatum]

taslaklar.konu: Tuition fee exemption – Abitur obtained at a German school abroad (Istanbul)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear TUM Student Service Center,
I am a Turkish citizen and expect to obtain the German Abitur at a German school abroad in Istanbul. Your tuition page states that students who obtained their higher education entrance qualification within the German education system (e.g. Abitur) do not pay tuition fees.
1) Does an Abitur awarded by a German school abroad (Deutsche Auslandsschule) count as a qualification obtained within the German education system for this exemption?
2) If not, which tuition rate would apply to a Bachelor's student starting in winter semester 2028/29?
Kind regards,
[Name, date of birth]

taslaklar.konu: TestDaF ve Goethe-Zertifikat C1 — 2027–2028 tarihleri ve ücretleri
taslaklar.metin:
Sayın Goethe-Institut İstanbul Sınav Bürosu,
2028 yazında Almanya'da Almanca bir lisans programına başvurmayı planlıyorum.
1) Enstitünüzde 2027 sonbaharı ile 2028 Mayıs'ı arasında TestDaF (dijital ya da kağıt) ve Goethe-Zertifikat C1 oturumları açılacak mı? Tarihleri ve kayıt son günleri nedir?
2) Bu sınavların Türkiye'deki güncel ücreti nedir?
3) Dijital TestDaF sonucunun açıklanma süresi Türkiye'de de yaklaşık 3 hafta mıdır?
Saygılarımla,
[Ad Soyad]

taslaklar.konu: Grade conversion and documents for a Turkish Lisans degree (Master's application, WS 2027/28)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear uni-assist team,

I am a Turkish citizen in the final year of a 4-year Lisans (Bachelor) programme at a Turkish state university listed as H+ in anabin. I plan to apply for Master's programmes in engineering for the winter semester 2027/28 (VPD for TUM and TU Berlin).

1. For the grade conversion, will you use 2.00 out of 4.00 as the lowest passing grade, or the value in section 4.2 of my Diploma Supplement if it differs?
2. Can I apply with a transcript issued via e-Devlet covering the first seven semesters, and submit the final diploma later?
3. Is a translation by a sworn translator in Turkey required if my university issues the transcript and Diploma Supplement in English?

Thank you for your written confirmation.

Kind regards,
[Name, date of birth, applicant number]

taslaklar.konu: English proficiency via English-medium Turkish Bachelor and tuition fee for WS 2027/28
taslaklar.metin:
Dear TUM Admissions team,

I hold (or will hold) a 4-year Bachelor's degree from a Turkish university where English is the language of instruction for 100% of the programme.

1. Will an official confirmation from my university that English was the language of instruction for the entire programme be accepted as proof of English for the Informatics M.Sc., without IELTS or TOEFL?
2. From winter semester 2027/28, which fee level (4,600 or 6,800 euros per semester) will apply to the Informatics M.Sc. for non-EU students?

Thank you for your written confirmation.

Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: GRE requirement for applicants with a Turkish Bachelor's degree
taslaklar.metin:
Dear International Office,

I am applying for the M.Sc. Informatik and M.Sc. Allgemeiner Maschinenbau for winter semester 2027/28 with a Bachelor's degree from a Turkish university (Turkey is a member of the European Higher Education Area but not of the EU).

1. Please confirm that the GRE General Test is mandatory for my application and that the thresholds in the current examination regulations apply.
2. For M.Sc. Allgemeiner Maschinenbau, which German language certificates and levels are required at enrolment?

Thank you for your written confirmation.

Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: GRE exemption for a Turkish Bachelor's degree (Computer Science M.Sc.)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear KIT team,

I plan to apply for the Computer Science M.Sc. for winter semester 2027/28 with a Bachelor's degree from a Turkish university. Turkey is a full member of the European Higher Education Area and a signatory of the Lisbon Recognition Convention.

Could you please confirm in writing that I am exempt from submitting the GRE under the programme's admission rules?

Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Studentenvisum WS 2027/28: Finanzierungsnachweis 2027 und Termin über Auslandsportal
taslaklar.metin:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

ich bin türkische Staatsangehörige/r und plane ein Masterstudium in Deutschland ab dem Wintersemester 2027/28.

1. Welcher monatliche Betrag für das Sperrkonto gilt für Visumanträge im Jahr 2027?
2. Findet nach der Registrierung im Auslandsportal der Termin zur Abgabe der Fingerabdrücke im Generalkonsulat oder bei iDATA statt, und fallen dabei zusätzliche Servicegebühren an?
3. Welche Krankenversicherung wird für das Visum akzeptiert?

Vielen Dank für Ihre schriftliche Auskunft.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Name, Geburtsdatum]

taslaklar.konu: Eligibility of Turkish citizens for DAAD Master's scholarships 2028/29
taslaklar.metin:
Dear DAAD Information Centre Istanbul,

I am a Turkish citizen and will complete my Bachelor's degree in engineering in 2027.

1. Are Turkish citizens eligible for the 'Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines' and for EPOS? The country list in the scholarship database does not show Turkey.
2. When will the next DAAD-TEV Master's scholarship call open, and what is its deadline?

Thank you for your reply.

Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Goethe-Zertifikat C2 ve TestDaF 2027 tarihleri ve ücretleri
taslaklar.metin:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

ich benötige für ein deutschsprachiges Masterstudium ab Wintersemester 2027/28 einen Sprachnachweis.

1. An welchen Terminen bieten Sie im ersten Halbjahr 2027 das Goethe-Zertifikat C2 (GDS) in Istanbul an, und wie hoch ist die Prüfungsgebühr für externe Teilnehmende?
2. Bieten Sie in Istanbul auch den digitalen TestDaF an? Wenn ja, zu welchen Terminen und zu welcher Gebühr?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Name]

taslaklar.kime: Politecnico di Torino — Apply@polito / Segreteria Generale Studenti
taslaklar.konu: Corso di laurea in italiano 2028/29 – certificazione B2 e tempi CILS (candidato non UE residente in Turchia)
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Ufficio,
sono uno studente turco residente a Istanbul e frequento una scuola superiore statale turca (diploma nel giugno 2028). Vorrei iscrivermi a un corso di laurea in ingegneria erogato in italiano per l'a.a. 2028/29.
1) Il termine per caricare la certificazione di lingua italiana B2 sarà simile a quello del 2026/27 (22 maggio)?
2) Un certificato rilasciato dall'Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Istanbul dopo un esame finale, con indicazione del livello QCER, è accettato come esonero (Allegato B, lettera d)?
3) Se sostengo la CILS B2 nella sessione di aprile 2028, è sufficiente presentare il risultato dopo il 22 maggio, oppure serve il certificato entro la scadenza?
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome, data di nascita]

taslaklar.kime: Politecnico di Milano — Ufficio Ammissioni (Ingegneria, lauree in italiano)
taslaklar.konu: Candidato non UE: lauree in italiano, TOLC-I e certificazione CLIQ B2 (a.a. 2028/29)
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Ufficio Ammissioni,
sono uno studente non UE residente in Turchia, al penultimo anno di scuola superiore nel 2026/27, e vorrei iscrivermi a una laurea in ingegneria erogata in italiano nel 2028/29.
1) Il bando 2027/28 prevederà ancora l'accesso anticipato con TOL o test alternativo (TOLC-I) ≥75/100 al penultimo anno, e le stesse regole valgono per i candidati non UE del contingente riservato?
2) Entro quale data devo presentare la certificazione CLIQ B2 per poter essere validato su Universitaly e richiedere il visto?
3) Un TOLC-I sostenuto nel 2027 è valido per l'immatricolazione nel 2028/29?
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome, data di nascita]

taslaklar.kime: Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Istanbul (iicistanbul@esteri.it)
taslaklar.konu: CILS Due-B2 a Istanbul 2027-2028: sessioni, costi e tempi dei risultati
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Istituto,
vorrei ottenere la certificazione CILS Due-B2 (sistema CLIQ) per l'iscrizione universitaria in Italia nel 2028.
1) In quali delle sessioni CILS 2027 e 2028 (calendario dell'Università per Stranieri di Siena) il vostro Istituto organizza il livello B2, e con quali scadenze di iscrizione?
2) Qual è la quota d'esame per il livello B2 presso il vostro Istituto?
3) In quanto tempo sono disponibili i risultati e il certificato?
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome]

taslaklar.kime: Consolato Generale d'Italia a Istanbul — Ufficio Visti / Studi
taslaklar.konu: Diploma di una scuola italiana paritaria a Istanbul ed esonero dalla prova di lingua
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Consolato,
la circolare MUR 2026-27/2027-28 esonera dalla prova di lingua italiana i titolari del diploma conseguito presso scuole italiane statali e paritarie all'estero.
1) Il diploma rilasciato dal liceo italiano di Istanbul rientra in questa categoria?
2) Questi studenti partecipano alle immatricolazioni a parità di condizioni con gli studenti italiani (fuori dal contingente riservato)?
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome]

taslaklar.kime: Politecnico di Milano, International Admissions (yüksek lisans)
taslaklar.konu: Turkish bachelor's degree: English-medium exemption, Italian level, final-year applicants (a.y. 2027/28)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear International Admissions Office,

I am a Turkish citizen holding (or completing in June 2027) a 4-year bachelor's degree (240 ECTS) from a Turkish state university, and I plan to apply to a Laurea Magistrale for a.y. 2027/28. Could you please confirm in writing:

1. For the English-medium exemption for Turkey, is an official letter from my university stating that at least 75% of courses were taught in English sufficient, or do you also require IELTS/TOEFL?
2. For programmes taught in Italian, what is the minimum Italian level required for admission, and which certificates (CELI, CILS, PLIDA, cert.it) do you accept?
3. If I apply in the Early bird period (1 October to 1 December 2026) as a final-year student, which document should I upload instead of the degree certificate, and by what date must the degree be awarded?
4. Is the CIMEA/ARDI Statement of Comparability accepted at enrolment in place of the Dichiarazione di valore?

Thank you for your help.
Kind regards,
[Name, Surname, date of birth, application number if any]

taslaklar.kime: Politecnico di Torino, Recruitment and Admissions Unit
taslaklar.konu: Master's admission 2027/28: English-medium Turkish degree and tuition for Turkish citizens
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Recruitment and Admissions Unit,

I am a Turkish citizen with a 4-year bachelor's degree from a Turkish university, planning to apply to a Master's degree programme for a.y. 2027/28. Could you please confirm:

1. Turkey is not in the list of countries whose English-medium degrees are exempt from the English certificate. Is an official statement of English medium of instruction from my Turkish university accepted, or must I submit IELTS/TOEFL (minimum IELTS 5.5)?
2. In Annex 2 of the 2026/27 Tuition Fee Regulations, the amount for Türkiye is EUR 1,709. Does this amount already include the regional tax (EUR 140), stamp duty (EUR 16) and insurance (EUR 5)?
3. When will the calls for a.y. 2027/28 for applicants with a non-Italian qualification be published, and will the pre-enrolment deadlines on Universitaly be similar to 2026/27?

Thank you in advance.
Kind regards,
[Name, Surname, date of birth]

taslaklar.kime: Politecnico di Milano, Financial Aid / Diritto allo Studio (ve anlaşmalı CAF)
taslaklar.konu: ISEEU parificato with family income and assets in Turkey (DSU a.y. 2027/28)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Financial Aid Unit,

I will enrol in the first year of a Laurea Magistrale in a.y. 2027/28. My family lives in Turkey and all income and assets are there. Could you please confirm:

1. Turkey and Italy are parties to the Hague Apostille Convention. Is an apostille on the Turkish income, property and family documents accepted, or must they be legalised by the Italian consulate?
2. Which Turkish documents are accepted as proof of income (for example, tax office income statement, social security records) and of property (land registry certificate showing square metres), and must each be translated into Italian by a sworn translator?
3. The 2026/27 call states that, from the 2027/28 call, foreign financial documents will be assessed against the minimum means required for the study visa. Does this mean the declared family income must be at least EUR 10,179.85 per year, or is the threshold calculated differently?
4. What is the expected deadline to submit documents to the CAF for first-year students in 2027?

Thank you.
Kind regards,
[Name, Surname, codice fiscale if available]

taslaklar.konu: Visto per studio Laurea Magistrale 2027/28: certificazione lingua inglese e dichiarazione di valore
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Ufficio Visti,

sono un cittadino turco residente a Istanbul e intendo iscrivermi a una Laurea Magistrale in lingua inglese per l'a.a. 2027/28. Vorrei chiedere conferma scritta su tre punti:

1. Per verificare il livello B2 di inglese, il Consolato accetta la dichiarazione ufficiale della mia università turca che il corso di laurea è stato erogato in inglese, oppure è necessaria una certificazione internazionale (IELTS, TOEFL o equivalente)?
2. Per la mia laurea turca, se presento l'attestato di comparabilità ARDI/CIMEA e l'attestato di verifica CIMEA, è necessaria anche la Dichiarazione di valore? Se sì, il Consolato di Istanbul la rilascia per i residenti della circoscrizione, con quali tempi e costi?
3. Quali sono i tempi medi di rilascio del visto per studio presentato tramite iDATA nel periodo luglio-settembre?

Ringrazio per l'attenzione.
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome, Cognome, numero di passaporto]

taslaklar.kime: Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Istanbul (iicistanbul@esteri.it)
taslaklar.konu: Certificazione CILS Due-B2: sessioni 2027 e costi
taslaklar.metin:
Gentile Istituto Italiano di Cultura,

ho bisogno di una certificazione di lingua italiana di livello B2 per iscrivermi a una Laurea Magistrale in Italia nel settembre 2027. Potreste indicarmi:

1. le sessioni CILS Due-B2 del 2027 organizzate presso il vostro Istituto, con le scadenze di iscrizione;
2. la quota d'esame per il livello B2;
3. i tempi di consegna dei risultati e del certificato.

Grazie mille.
Cordiali saluti,
[Nome, Cognome, telefono]

taslaklar.kime: JKU Linz Admissions Office / Universität Klagenfurt Admissions Office
taslaklar.konu: Turkish Lise Diploması, YKS timing and AP exams – BSc Artificial Intelligence / Robotics and AI
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I am a student at a Turkish state high school and will graduate in June [year]. I plan to apply for the BSc [programme] taught in English. According to the BMBWF recommendation for Türkiye (October 2025), I need a YKS placement with at least 180 points. Could you please confirm in writing:
1. Whether AP exam results (College Board, scores 3–5) can replace or supplement the YKS requirement in any way.
2. Since YKS placement results are published in mid to late August, whether I should apply for the summer semester, or whether a later submission of the placement document is possible for the winter semester.
3. Which English certificates and minimum scores you accept for level B2.
4. (Klagenfurt only) Whether the VFS Global competence check applies to me, its fee, and when it must be completed.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.kime: Universität Wien Studienzulassung / TU Wien Studienabteilung
taslaklar.konu: Zulassung mit türkischem Lise Diploması: YKS, Deutsch A2/C1 und Vorstudienlehrgang
taslaklar.metin:
Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
ich besuche ein staatliches Gymnasium in der Türkei und schließe im Juni [Jahr] ab. Ich möchte ein deutschsprachiges Bachelorstudium [Studium] beginnen. Bitte bestätigen Sie mir schriftlich:
1. Ob die YKS-Platzierung (Yerleşme Puanı mindestens 180) aus dem Jahr [Jahr] für das Sommersemester [Jahr] bzw. Wintersemester [Jahr] akzeptiert wird, auch wenn ich mich an der zugewiesenen türkischen Hochschule nicht eingeschrieben habe.
2. Ob ein Deutschnachweis auf Niveau A2 für den Antrag genügt und welche C1-Zertifikate (z. B. ÖSD Zertifikat C1, Goethe-Zertifikat C1) für die Zulassung als ordentliche Studierende anerkannt werden.
3. Welche Ergänzungsprüfungen (Mathematik, Physik, Chemie) für mein Zeugnis voraussichtlich vorgeschrieben werden und ob AP-Prüfungen (College Board) diese ersetzen können.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Master's admission with a Turkish bachelor's degree: legalisation and English proof
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admission Office,
I hold (or will hold by [month/year]) a four-year bachelor's degree (240 ECTS) in [field] from [university], Türkiye, and I intend to apply for the English-taught Master's programme [programme] for the winter semester 2027/28. Could you please confirm in writing:
1) Whether an apostille issued in Türkiye on my diploma and transcript satisfies your legalisation requirement, or whether further legalisation is needed.
2) Which English certificates and minimum scores (e.g. IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT) you accept as proof of level B2, and whether a medium-of-instruction letter from my Turkish university is accepted.
3) Whether a final-year applicant may apply with a current transcript and submit the degree certificate later, and by which date.
Thank you for your help.
Kind regards,
[Name, date of birth, nationality]

taslaklar.konu: Tuition fee reimbursement for students from Türkiye – eligibility criteria
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Registrar's Office,
I am a Turkish citizen planning to start a Master's programme at TU Graz in the winter semester 2027/28. Your website lists Türkiye among the countries eligible for tuition fee reimbursement. Could you please send me the eligibility criteria (e.g. academic performance, income, minimum ECTS) and confirm whether first-semester Master's students can apply in the period 15 December – 31 March?
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Turkish Lise Diploması: YKS placement, reduced entrance examination and timeline
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I attend a Turkish state high school and will graduate in June [year]. According to the swissuniversities list (2026/27), I need a certificate of university admission in the desired subject from a recognised Turkish university (YKS placement) and the reduced entrance examination. Could you please confirm in writing:
1. For a start in autumn [year], by which date I must submit the application and which entrance examination session (January or another) applies.
2. Whether a YKS placement from a previous year is accepted, and for how many years.
3. Whether AP exam results (College Board) play any role for holders of a Turkish diploma.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Turkish diploma: CMS grade threshold and entrance examination eligibility during the final school year
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admission Service,
I attend a Turkish state high school (science track) and will graduate in June [year]. Could you please confirm in writing:
1. Whether I may register for the entrance examination (registration 1 October–1 December) while I am still in my final school year.
2. How the 80% threshold for the CMS is applied to the Turkish 100-point grading scale (mathematics, physics and general average), and which school years are taken into account.
3. The tuition fee per semester for a student with a foreign certificate in [year].
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Medium of instruction exemption for a Turkish English-taught bachelor's degree
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I am completing a four-year bachelor's degree in [field] at [university], Türkiye, where the entire programme is taught in English. I plan to apply in the November 2026 window for the MSc [programme] starting in autumn 2027. Could you please confirm:
1) Whether an official letter from my university confirming English as the sole language of instruction exempts me from submitting an English test certificate.
2) The minimum IELTS/TOEFL scores required for this programme if a test is needed.
3) Whether the GRE is required or recommended for this programme.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: English requirement and 2027 deadlines for a Turkish applicant
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I hold a bachelor's degree from [university], Türkiye (taught in [English/Turkish]) and plan to apply for the Master in [programme] for September 2027. Could you please confirm: 1) the English proficiency requirement and whether an official medium-of-instruction letter is accepted; 2) the 2027 application deadlines and the application fee; 3) whether the Master Excellence Fellowship covers the tuition fee.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Turkish diploma with AP exams – timing of AP results and graduates
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I attend a Turkish state high school and will graduate in June [year]. I plan to take the following AP exams: [list, incl. Calculus BC and Physics]. Could you please confirm in writing:
1. If one of the mandatory AP exams is taken in May of my final year, whether results published in July can still be submitted after the 15 June deficiency deadline for a September start.
2. Whether a diploma obtained in an earlier academic year is accepted for applicants who have already graduated.
3. Whether the AP requirements published for September 2027 are expected to change for September [year].
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Turkish Lise Diploması with AP – physics requirement and YKS
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I attend a Turkish state high school and plan to apply for the BSc [programme]. Could you please confirm in writing:
1. Whether AP Physics 1 together with AP Physics 2 meets the physics requirement, given that AP Physics C is considered insufficient.
2. Whether a Turkish national university entrance exam (YKS) result is required in addition to the diploma and four AP exams.
3. Which English certificates and minimum scores you accept for this programme.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: 2027/28 deadlines and GPA requirement for a Turkish bachelor's degree
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I am completing a four-year bachelor's degree in [field] at [university], Türkiye (CGPA [x.xx]/4.00). I plan to apply for the MSc [programme] starting September 2027. Could you please confirm: 1) whether the application deadline for non-EU/EFTA applicants for this programme is 15 January 2027 or 1 April 2027; 2) whether a country-specific CGPA requirement applies to Turkish degrees or the general 75% rule; 3) whether a GRE score is required or recommended; 4) the 2027 deadline for TU Delft excellence scholarships.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Residence permit procedure (MVV) for Turkish nationals and English score requirement
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I am a Turkish citizen applying for the MSc [programme] for September 2027. Could you please confirm: 1) whether the university applies for my MVV and residence permit as a recognised sponsor; 2) the minimum IELTS/TOEFL scores for this programme; 3) the Holland Scholarship deadline for 2027/28.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.konu: Turkish Lise Diploması with YKS – deadline for visa applicants and AP Calculus
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I attend a Turkish state high school and will graduate in June [year]. I wish to apply for the Bachelor of Engineering Technology (Group T, English). Could you please confirm in writing:
1. The application deadline for a Turkish national who needs a visa, for the academic year [year].
2. Whether the YKS result (published in July) and the placement result (published in August) can be submitted after the application deadline, and which YKS score is required for this programme.
3. Whether an AP Calculus result is required or recommended as proof of mathematics, and whether AP results can replace the YKS requirement.
4. The minimum English test scores accepted.
Kind regards,
[Name]

taslaklar.kime: ULB, Service des inscriptions / École polytechnique de Bruxelles
taslaklar.konu: Diplôme turc (Lise Diploması) : équivalence, examen spécial d'admission et niveau de français
taslaklar.metin:
Madame, Monsieur,
Je suis élève dans un lycée public turc et j'obtiendrai mon diplôme en juin [année]. Je souhaite m'inscrire en Bachelier en sciences de l'ingénieur, orientation ingénieur civil. Pourriez-vous me confirmer par écrit :
1. Les dates de l'examen spécial d'admission pour l'année [année] et s'il est possible de le passer avant d'obtenir l'équivalence.
2. Le niveau de français exigé et les certificats acceptés (DELF, DALF, TCF).
3. Si la contribution complémentaire pour les étudiants hors UE s'applique aux ressortissants turcs.
Veuillez agréer mes salutations distinguées.
[Nom]

taslaklar.konu: Application deadline 2027-2028 and tuition fee for a Turkish applicant (visa required)
taslaklar.metin:
Dear Admissions Office,
I am a Turkish citizen holding a four-year bachelor's degree in [field] from [university], Türkiye. I intend to apply for the [Master programme] starting in September 2027 and will need a student visa. Could you please confirm: 1) the application deadline for 2027-2028 for non-EEA applicants requiring a visa; 2) the 2027-2028 tuition fee for this programme for non-EEA students; 3) whether a GRE score is recommended.
